ov: A small, highly social mongoose of southern Africa. Packs of up to 30 live in large burrow systems, and non-breeding members help raise the dominant pair’s pups. Its black, crescent-shaped ears close to keep out dirt while it digs.
df: Mainly insects, especially beetles, moths and butterflies; also eggs, amphibians, reptiles, small birds, seeds and scorpions, whose venom it is immune to.
fx: A meerkat burrow system is about 5 m across, with around 15 entrances and two or three levels.
Adults teach pups to eat venomous scorpions by removing the sting first.
notes: The existing fact (takes turns on sentry duty) is confirmed: pack members take turns at jobs such as keeping a lookout for predators. PAGE ADDITIONS 2026-10-20 (ov, df, fx), from the cached Wikipedia text.
